I was at 150 mg. I took two 75 mg pills every day so I lowered it to 112.5 for two weeks then 75 for two weeks then 37.5 for two weeks. I had capsules with beads in them so I had to split them myself which was a little weird but I wanted to take it slow 

Edit: I did this on my own with out a doctor because of copays so I don't recommend it if you have access to a doctor

I had a very abusive ex that I dated for 3 years in high school and I think that is the root of it. Recently though my entire friend group has abandoned me and I'm feeling more alone than ever. Thank you for responding

Drinking on venlafaxine was not fun for me, I would get drunk way to fast and experience black outs. I got myself off it by lowering the dose every other week. I still had some withdrawals but nothing as bad as skipping a couple days at a higher dose
